text.body:
śriyai namaḥ| śrī rāmacandrāyanamaḥ| śrī madvikhanasamahāgurave namaḥ śrī madbhyo bhṛgumarīcyatrikaśyapebhyonamaḥ| śrī vaikhānasabhagavacchāstre bhagavadbhṛgu maharṣi praṇītaḥ yajñādhikāraḥ
<1>
atha prathamo'dhyāyaḥ śrautasmārtādikaṃ karma nikhilaṃ yena sūtritam tasmai samastavedārtha vide vikhanase namaḥ ṛṣi praśnottaram| bhṛguṃ munivaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nānālokanivāsinaḥ kuśāsane samāsīnaṃ nārāyaṇa parāyaṇam| 1 samāsādya praṇamyaiva bhagavatsaktacetasaḥ kena mārgeṇa kairmantraiḥ kaṃ devaṃ niyatendriyāḥ 2 samarcayantaḥ paramaṃ padaṃ gaccheyuravyamam ṛṣe tatsarvamākhyāhi paramaṃ vadataṃ vara| 3 ..... ...... ..... ..... .... arcana praśaṃsā bhṛguruvācaḥ yuṣmābhiścoditaṃ sarvaṃ sādhu vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ manasā devaṃ smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ param| 4 śrutyanukūlamārgeṇa caturvedodbhavaistathā mantraissamastalokeśa marcayeddhari mavyayam| 5 tenaiva bhaktyā vaikuṇṭhaṃ sahasā svayameva ca labhate tatpadaṃ nāsti na daivaṃ keśavātparam| 6 taṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayennityaṃ sarvasādhanaṃ sādhanam sarvamuktipradaṃ nityaṃ sarvakāma phalapradam| 7 grāmagrāhārayossamya garcanaṃ tannivāsinām sarvasiddhipradaṃ nityaṃ putra pautra vivardhanam 8 sāmānyamagnihotraṃ syādanagnīnaṃ tapodhanāḥ sāgnināmapiśāntyarthaṃ dvitīyaṃ sarvasiddhidam|| 9 arcanadvai vidhyam tadarcanaṃ dvidhā prokta mūrtañca samūrtakam agnau hutamamūrtaṃsyā tsamūrtaṃ berapūjanam| 10 amūrtaṃ yajamānasya hyabhāve ca vinaśyati acchinnaṃ śāśvataṃ nityaṃ pratimārādhanaṃ param| 11 sūtre vikhanasā prokta magnyādhānādikaṃ tathā agnyāghāra prabhṛtyantaṃ sviṣṭākārañca sarvataḥ| 12 tathā caredyathāmārgaṃ pratimārādhane'pi ca ālayārādhanāmārgaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathākramam| 13 bhūparīkṣāṃ samārabhya niṣkṛtyantaṃ sa śilpakam kṛtsnaṃ mantrakriyāsārthamṛju vyaktaṃ tapodhanāḥ| iti śrī vaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ yajñādhikāre ṛṣi praśnavidhirnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ
<2>
atha dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhūparīkṣā vidhikramam ārambhakālātpūrvasmin yajamāno guruṃ varet 1 vaikhānasaṃ tapaśśīlaṃ nityahoma parāyaṇam pāraṃ paryāgataṃ śiṣṭaṃ doṣairanyairvi varjitam| 2 vipraṃ taṃ varayitvā tu yācayetsaṃ prapūjya ca śāstrajñaṃ bandhusampanna māhūya sthapatiṃ punaḥ| 3 māseṣu caitrakaṃ naiva śeṣamāse śubhe dine grāmasya yajamānasya cānukūle śubhodaye| 4 vaiṣṇavīṃ bhūmimāsādya śuddhiṃ kṛtvā yathāśubham pūrvedyureva śarvaryā maṅkurārpaṇam mārabhet 5 brāhmaṇo yajamānaścettadgṛhe vāṅkurārpaṇam anyaśce tatra vā kuryāttatra cetsadya eva tu| 6 bhūmiṃ mahurteka syācāryaḥ proṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ asayitvā'tha hastābhyāṃ bhūsūktenābhimarśa yet| 7 dvitālayata vistārāvagāḍhaṃ caturaśrakam khanitvā pāṃsumuddhṛtya prakṣipettāṃ mṛdaṃ guruḥ| 8 adhike cenmahovṛddhiṃ hīne hīnaṃ same samam vidyādathānyaissaṃlakṣya nimittairvā samārabhet| 9 grāme cettatsabhāsthāne parīkṣyaiva ca karṣayet grāmārthaṃ karṣayetpūrvaṃ nirmite vāstumadhyame| 10 paścādālaya māviśya bhūparīkṣāṃ vinā'tra tu kalpayedvidhinā paścādgavādīn sanniveśayet| 11 niścitya vidhinā vāstu padāni parikalpayet kārayitvā 'dhivānā mantraissamabhyarcya baliṃ dadet| 12 vāstuvinyāsaḥ grāme brahmabhāgaṃ vibhajya ca caturdhā japanāṃśe tu pañcamūrtī ssamarcayet| 13 tadaṃśe pūjakagṛhaṃ dakṣiṇe cottare'tha vā paścime vā vidigdeśe kalpayetta tsamīpataḥ| 14 svapanaṃ ca tathai śānyāṃ goṣṭhāgārañca pāvake nair ṛtyāmāpaṇasthānaṃ kārayettān yathāvidhi| 15 sahasraviprānnyūneṣu grāmeṣvapi ca madhyame śataṃ śatadvayādyeṣu caimamūrti mathārcayet| 16 āsanaṃ sthānakaṃ vā'tha śayanaṃ bhogameva ca kalpayedgrāmavṛddhyarthaṃ rāmakṛṣṇau tu vā punaḥ 17 uttare madhyavīthyāṃ tadvāruṇe harimandiram sthānakaṃ vā sanaṃ cātha dakṣiṇe vā yathocatam| 18 harasya dhāma vaiśānye bāhye tatpraṅmukhaṃ caret sthāne 'gnergehamkasya paścimābhimukhaṃ tathā| 19 saumye tatprāṅmukhāṃ durgāṃ paiśāce ṣaṇmukhaṃ yame vighneśasya tu vāyavyāṃ mātṛkoṣṭaṃ guhasya ca 20 kanyādṛṣṭī raveradṛṣṭirvighneśasya guhasya ca gramāsya sukhadā syāttaddharadṛṣṭhiranarthadā| 21 sarvābhivṛddhidaṃ viṣṇorgrāmādiṣu veśeṣataḥṭa sā dṛṣṭissaumyarūpatvātthathā syātpṛṣṭhameva ca 22 tathaiva pañcaberāṃśca vāstubāhye samarcayet dhruvārcañca viśeṣeṇa diśāsu vidiśāsu ca 23 bhogaṃ cetthpāpayedvidvān paiśāce madhyamaṃ vinā gramaprekṣaṃ tathā bāhye yogavirau dhruvārcanam| 24 bhogaṃ cettaddhruvārcaṃ vai vāstunyena prakalpayet vāripārśve vane'nyatra dhruvaṃ vā'tha dhruvārcanam| 25 yathoktaṃ sthāpayedvidvān prāṅmukhaṃ vā yathocitam nagarādau madhye viṣṇuṃ nārcayedanyadikṣi ca 26 arcayetpaścime viṣṇuṃ śrī bhūmisahitaṃ śubham| 27 iti śrī vaikhānase bhagavacchāstre uttaratantre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ yajñādhikāre bhūparīkṣādi vidhirnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|
<3>
atha tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ karṣaṇam| ataḥ varaṃ pravakṣyāmi karṣaṇā vidhimuttamam māseṣviṣṭadine kartuścāpyanu kūlake| 1 yatra devālayaṃ kuryātsaprākāraṃ caturdiśam sīmāvinirṇayaṃ kṛtvā tṛṇādīn śodhayecchubham 2 arkatālaṃ yugaṃ kuryāddhalaṃ vai bhūtatālakam vedatālamṛṣiñcaiva kṣiṇiṃ dvādaśatālakam 3 vaṃśadajñgulanāhaṃ syat ṣaṭprādeśaṃ pratodakam evaṃ lakṣaṇa saṃyuktaṃ yuktyā śeṣaṃ prayojayet 4 mauñjyā ca rajjumādāya vṛṣau śvetau subandhayet khurau śṛ ṅgau suvarṇena tāvābaddhya tṛṇaṃ dadet 5 sarvāvādya samāyuktaṃ yajamāno gurustadhā sārtha ntu vaiṣṇavairbūmiṃ dīpapūrvaṃ praveśayet 6 tatra paścimābhāge tu prapāṃ kṛtvā sa lakṣaṇam paritaḥ prāvaraṇaṃ kṛtvā vitānādyairvi bhūṣayet 7 vrīhibhiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā vaṣvastenasya madhyame tatra paścimabhāge tu cakrasyaivottare tathā 8 vīśasya vidhinā pīṭhaṃ bhāgamutāra samunnatam kṛtvā prāgāsa naṃ kūrcaṃ vidhāyordhve samarcayet| 9 havissamyaṅni vedyaiva vīśāmita sudarśanān puṇyāhaṃ vācayutvānte bandhayedvṛṣabhau punaḥ 10 ācāryo yajamānena datto vai dikṣimāṃ punaḥ mauñjīrajjuṃ samādāya 'rudrama' nyeti bandhayet| 11 yugalaṅgalau tathā''baddhya 'tryamba' keti vadan budhaḥ vaiṣṇavaṃ mantramucārya prāgantaṃ karṣayedbhavam| 12 paścātkarṣakamāhūya svalaṃ kṛtyā manaḥ priyam viśvataḥ karaṣa yetyuktyā niyañjīyādgururbhudhaḥ| 13 saṅgṛhya bījān kaṅgvādīn yāvadaṅkura daraśanam tāvajjaleṣu nikṣipya viṣṇū sūktena vāpayet| 14 vāruṇena jalaṃ datvā rakṣāṃ kṛtvāyathāvidi samabhyarcyaiva tān devān samudvāsya punarguruḥ 15 aṅkure parūpūrṇe tu gogaṇebhyo nivedayet atha sadyaḥ kartumicce ddūrvā astīrya sandadet 16 garbhālayapradeśe tu śuddhiṃ kṛtvāḥḥ manoramam vrīhibhiḥsthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā dvihastāyata vistṛtam| 17 pūrvāgrāścottarāgrāśca vargarekhāstathā kuru karṇasūtradvayopetaṃ catuśśira samanvitam| 18 vedato'ṅgula saṃyuktaṃ nāgairnaścatuṣpatham| sūtrāṣṭayoge dhātāraṃ diśilāśūlayestathā| 19 lokapālān samabhyarcya baliṃ datvā'tha pāyasaiḥ kṛtvācāryaḥsvayaṃ svayaṃ pūrvaṃ vai śilpinā vinā| 20 paścādatra ca taddevān śilpinā cā bhivandayet saṃśodya viśvaṃ saṅgṛhya vāyasebhyaḥ pradīyatām| 21 atra śaṅkuṃ susaṃsthāpya guru stacchilpinā saha diśo niścitya dhāmārthaṃ vamānaṃḥ vidhinārabhet| 22 iti śrī vaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ yajñādhikāre tṛtīya'dhyāyaḥ
<4>
yajñādhikāraḥ| atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ śaṅkusthāpanam| śaṅkupratiṣṭhāmārgañca pravakṣyāmi taphodhanāḥ prāsādanirmitisthāne samaṃ kṛtvā bhuva stalam| 1 gocarmamātra tatraiva gomayenopalepayet pragantaṃ cottarāntañca madhye sūtraṃ prasārayet| 2 tanmadhye śaṅkusaṃsthānaṃ yājñikaistarubhistathā śaṅkuṃ kuryādvidhānena tasyottuṅgaṃ vitasthinā| 3 vitastyā mūlanāhaṃ syādagranāhaṃ navāṅgulam kramātkṛśamavakraṃ syācchaṃgorlakṣaṇameva ca| 4 tanmadhye maṇḍalaṃ kuryā cchaṅkordviguṇa mānataḥ sthāpayedudayātpūrve śaṅkhanāda samāyutam| 5 tasminnadhipamāditya mindrādīn parito'rcayet rekhāgatāyāṃ chāyāyāṃ paścime bindhu marpayet| 6 tathā'parāhne rekhāyāṃ prāggate bindumarpayet tat ṣaṇṇavatikaṃ bhagaṃ kṛttaikāṃśaṃ tadaṅgulam| 7 meṣe ca vṛṣabhe śūnyaṃ tulāmāse dviyaṅgulam karkaṭe vṛścike mīne tenaiva caturaṅgulam| 8 cāpe kumbhe ṣaḍaṅgulyaṃ makare'ṣṭāṅgulaṃ kramāt aṅgulīrmāsi māsyuktāḥ triṃśadbhāgaṃ vibhajya ca 9 gatarkṣāṇāstu yuktyā tairaṃśaṃ nītvāva śeṣitam tadbindvoruttare yāmye nītvā bandhuṃ samarpayet| 10 sūtraṃ prāsāraye dvidvān madhye prāgantameva ca dakṣiṇottarato binduṃ matsavadbhramayodbudhaḥ| 11 tatpucchānanayormadhye sūtraṃ paścātprasārya ca evaṃ diśo viniścitya mūlasthānañca kalpayet|12 nirmite 'tra vimānasya utsedhārdhaṃ samaṃ tathā janāntaṃ vā śilāntaṃ vā khānayeducitaṃ sudhīḥ| 13 vistārāyāmasīnānte tatkhātvā sudṛḍhāya ca pañcahastaṃ caturhastaṃ trihastaṃ vā'dhikaṃ kramāt| 14 vālukairviśvataḥ pūrva toyena saha miśritam dṛḍhīkṛtvātivṛkṣyairvā hastipādena vā budhaḥ| 15 daśahante tu kramaśastatkhātaṃ pañcadhā caret tribhāgāvanate vidvān śilā vā ceṣṭakā'thavā| 16 yaddravyeṇa kṛtaṃ dhāma taddravyeṇa ca vālukai śanaiḥ śanai statsudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā tatra vicakṣaṇaḥ |17 yugmāyugma vibhāgena niścityaiva ca pūrvataḥ tenoktavidhinā vidvāniṣṭakāṃ prathamāṃ nyaset| 18 vimānameka dravyeṇa kṛtaṃ ceduttamaṃ viduḥ uparīṣṭādvṛtestatra iṣṭakābhiḥ kṛta natu yat| 19 madhyamaṃ talabhedeṣu taruṇācchādite sati kaniṣṭaṃ tadvijānīyanmiśrametaiḥ kṛtaṃ budhāḥ| 20 vimānārtha śilālakṣaṇādi| śilābhedaṃ pravakṣyāmi vimānārthaṃ dvicottamaḥ śvetaṃ kṛṣṇañca raktañca miśrañcaiva caturvidham| 21 bhūgataṃ girajaṃ caiva vārijaṃ vā'tha cāharet vārijādgiricaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ giricādbūmījaṃ tathā| 22 ekayā śilayā dhāma kṛtaṃ ceduttamaṃ prabhoḥ śilābhyāṃ yatkṛtaṃ madhyaṃ tribhiriṣṭakayā saha| 23 kaniṣṭhaṃ tadvijānīyānmiśraṃ vā'miśrameva vā kārayellakṣaṇopetaṃ matimān śāstravittamaḥ| 24 śilāyāṃ parikartavyā iṣṭakā iṣṭakopari nācarestacchilābhista dviparītaṃ na kārayet| 25 śvetajopari kartavyai kṛṣṭajaṃ raktamiśrajau raktajopari miśraṃ vā śvetaṃ vā kārayedbudhaḥ| 26 kṛṣṇajopari śvetaṃ syādraktamiśrau ca varjayet| nācaretsvaprādhānau tau raktamiśrau vicakṣaṇaḥ 27 prasiddhabhavane viṣṇoḥ śvetajaṃ kṛṣṭameva vā kṛṣṇajopari śvetaṃ syādiṣṭakordhve śilāṃ vinā| 28 ācaredbhavane'nye tu prāsādādiṣu sarvaśaḥ vargāntamekadravyeṇa kārayetsaṅkaraṃ vinā| 29 upānādiṣu gaṇyeṣu dvidravyeṇa na kārayet kṛtaṃ cedābhicāraṃ syānniśraṃ tatmānna kārayet| 30 evaṃ buddhvā gururdhīmān yajamānabalānvitaḥ sārthaṃ tadyajamāne niścityāpi saśilpinā| 31 śubhodaye dine śuddhe sannyasyaiva tadiṣṭakāḥ ārabhedbhavanaṃ mantrī hastenoktena śāstravit| 32 iti śrī vaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktyāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ yajñādhikāre caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
<5>
atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ bālāvayavidhiḥ ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi bālālaya vidhakramam prathamāvaraṇe vā'tha dvitīyāvaraṇe'tha vā| 1 mūlasthānasya caiśānyāmaindre saumye viśeṣataḥ vāyavyāṃ paścime vā'tha kalpayettaruṇā'layam| 2 pañcahastaṃ samārabhya dvidvihasta vivardhanāt tridhā navakārāntaṃ syādbālāhārasya cāyatam| 3 catustālaṃ tritālaṃ vā viśālaṃ kuḍyamūlataḥ śiṣṭamantarviśālaṃ syātpañca saptakarāntakam| 4 samaṃ tripādamardhaṃ vā mukhamaṇḍapamiṣya te yathā mūlalayadvāraṃ tathā syāttaruṇālaye| 5 mṛdbhirvā'thṣṭakābhirvā kuḍyaṃ saśilayā budhaḥ prathameṣṭa kāñca garbhañca dvara saṃsthāpana kriyām| 6 vinaiva bālāgāre tu kārayedvidhicoditam dvārastambhaṃ kavāṭañca rakṣārthaṃ taruṇālaye| 7 mantreṇa sthāpayetratnān vinaiva ca talādi ṣu lupopari tṛṇācchannaṃ loṣṭācchādanameva vā 8 bahubhūmivimānaṃ cettalabhedakramādbudhaḥ antaraṃ dhātubhāgañca vibhajenmadhyame sudhīḥ| 9 ādibhūmiñca saṅkalpya devamānuṣamadhyame dvitalāya tathā dhīmān paiśāce tritalāya ca 10 dvitalaṃ mānuṣe yugmaṃ pañcamūrterviśeṣataḥ paiśāce parito madhye puruṣādīn sthāpayedbudhaḥ 11 ekaikaṃ taddvitāloccaṃ pañcamūrterviśeṣataḥ brahme caikapadaṃ dhīmānunnata ntu samācaret| 12 sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vā'tha tāmraṃ vā'tha svaśaktitaḥ dāravapritimāṃ vā'tha kṛtvā saṃsthāpayedbudhaḥ| 13 anyālaye'rcitaṃ śūnyaṃ samprāptañca punastathā yācitaṃ tadviturdhīmānācarettvarayā'nvitaḥ 14 atha vā tadgṛhārcāṃ vā sthāpayedbāladhāman mūlasthāpanakāle tu gṛhārcāṃ yācitāṃ tyajet| 15 mūlasthāpanakāle tu pratimāmālayāya ca kṛttvaiva sthāpayeddhīmānatha vā hārakaṃ caret 16 grāmasya yajamānasya cānukūle śubhe dine tasmāttu divasātpūrva maṅgurārpaṇa mācaret| 17 kṛtvā'kṣimocanaṃ paścāt kṣīre ganye jale tathā adhivāsya yāgaśālāyāṃ punaḥ stutvā vibhūṣayet| 18 madhyame śayanasthānaṃ pañcāgnīn parikalpayet| paryagnipañcagavyābhyāṃ viśvataḥ śodhayetkramāt| 19 droṇadvayaṃsusaṃpūrṇaṃ khaṇḍaspuṭita varjitam prakṣipyā'yudha cihnādīn kumbhaṃ saṃsādhayedguruḥ| 20 dhānyapīṭhe susannyasya pritiṣṭoktakrameṇa vai dhyāyan kumbhe samāvāhya snapanaṃ samyagācaret| 21 śayyāvedyāṃ tathā ''stīrya aṇḍacādīn yathākramam aropyopari deveśaṃ kumbena sahaśāyayet 22 puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra badhnīyātkautukaṃ tathā 'yadvaiṣṭavaṃ ' samuccārya prākchiraśśāyayeddharim| 23 uttarācchādanaṃ kṛtvā hautraṃ samyak praśaṃsya ca mūrtyāvāhanahomādīn pratiṣṭoktavadācaret 24 rātriśeṣaṃ vyapohyaiva snātvā snānavidhānataḥ yāgasthānaṃ praviśyaiva uddhareddhari mavyayam| 25 ācāryadakṣiṇāṃ datvā cararāśau śubhodaye kumbhaṃ bimbaṃ samādāya toyadhārā purassaram| 26 dhāmapradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā 'pratadviṣṇu 'riti bruvan saṃsthāpya vedyāṃ deveśaṃ devībhyāṃ svapanotsave 27 ātmasūktaṃ japitvā tu viṣṇusūktādikaṃ japet kumbhasthāṃ śaktimādāya dhyāyan viṣṇvidimūrtibhiḥ| 28 kumbhasthāṃ mūrthni cāvāhya devyādīn pariṣadgaṇān āvāhya cotsave'rcāyāṃ balibimye ca kautukāt| 29 dīpāddīpamivāvāhya samabhyarcya yathākramam puṇyāhaṃ vācayetta tatra pāyasādīn nivedayet| 30 āvāhanavisargau ca vinaiva vidhipūrvakam nitye naimittike dhīmān vidhinaiva samarcayet| 31 bālālaye dhruvārcāṃ cetkartumicchetsa jaṅgamam| tathā bālālayāṃ kṛtvā karbhagehe samasthale| 32 ādhārārthaṃ śilāṃ naiva iṣṭakābhirdṛḍhī kṛte tale vinā'tha ratnādīn sthāpayejjaṅgamaṃ tathā| 33 tatprāṇabhūmyā saṃyogaṃ jaṅgamatvātsaśailakam tatra thādīn samaṃ dhīmān sthāpayetkautukoktavam| 34 paścātyathokte sthāne taddhāma kṛtvā salakṣaṇam sthūpiśūlāvasānāntaṃ atha pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ sthānakādibhedhaḥ| athā taḥ sthānakādīnāṃ bhedaṃ vakṣye yathākramam śyāmalāṅgaṃ caturbhāhuṃ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ prabhum| 1 abhayaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ varadaṃ svagata ntu vā vāmañca devānabhyarcayetkramāt tato'bhyantraṃ praviśyaiva dravyamādāya pūrvavat 38 snapayetpūrvavanmantrī dhruvārcāṃ pūjayettathā avagrahādidurbhikṣe snāpanenā'śubhāni ca 39 naśyanti kuryāttasmācca prayatnāt svapanaṃ prabhoḥ eteṣāmapi dravyāṇāṃ mānaṃ yogaṃ pratikriyā 40 utpattirnavabhedāśca mayā proktāḥ purā khile tathā caredanuktāni sravāṇyanyāni mantrataḥ 41 karmānte tasya devyau ca snāpayediti kecana sahapīṭhe yadi bhavennāmādyaṃ karmaṇo'ntare 42 śuddhasnānaiḥ sahātrāpi snāpayenmāṃ mahīṃ prabhum devīyuktaṃ dhruvārcāṃ ceddevyau tatsnapanāntare 43 saṃsnāpya śuddhatoyenasaha śeṣaṃ samācaret iti śrī vaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ yajñādhikāre snapanadravyavidhirnāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ

yajñādhikāraḥ| atha ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| snapanabhedhāḥ| atha ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi snapanaṃ cādhamādhamam bhaktānāṃ durbhālānāñca kṣudra ñcāpi mahārthakam 1 sāmānyāni ca sarveṣāṃ bhavanti snapaneṣu ca tasmādgavyādibhirdravyaiḥ sarvauṣadhyudakāntakaiḥ 2 dravyaiḥ pradhānāḥ sampūrṇāḥ kalāśā dvādaśaiva ca vāripūrṇā upasnānakālaśā dvādaśa kramāt 3 haridrācūrṇa saṃyuktasalaśena sahaiva ca pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyāśca kalaśāścā tapodhanāḥ 4 snapanārthaṃ viśeṣeṇa pūrvoktadivase tathā aṅkurānarpayutvauva rakṣārtha ñcādhi vāsayet 5 pūrvoktamaṇḍape dhīrmā karmasūtraiḥ samasthale pañcaviṃśatpadaṃ kṛtvā bhittimānaṃ viśeṣataḥ 6 atra madhyapape śvabhraṃ parito'ṣṭau padāṃ styajet sañcāraṇārthañcaturo dvārārthaṃ dikṣu vai kramāt 7 kalaśasthāpanārthaṃ taccheṣite'rkapade tathā āḍhakaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā prasthaṃ vā kalaśamprati 8 saṅgṛhya vrīhibhiḥ pīṭhaṃ tatpadāyā mavistṛtam yathālābhodayaṃ kuryāddravyamprati pṛthak pṛthak 9 prokṣaṇollekhane pīṭhe darbhāṇāmāstaraṃ pṛthak kṛtvā saṅgṛhya kalaśān dravyairapi supūrayet 10 praṇavena kūrcān nikṣipya somasnānaṃ pṛthak pṛthak sāpidhānañca kṛtvā tu viṣṇugāyatriyā nyaset 11 gavyaṃ dadhyakṣatodañca ratnodaṃ vidiśāsu ca īśādyaṃ sannyasetpaścā ddvārāṇāṃ vāmapārśvake 12 ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ phalaṃ japyaṃ prāgādya ñcānyapārśvake madhu gandhaṃ kuśodañca sarvauṣadhyudakaṃ nyaset 13 vidhinā tatkrameṇaiva eteṣāṃ vāmapārśvataḥ sannyaseddadupasnānānnīlato yādhipāntare 14 sannyasyaiva ca hāridraṃ vastreṇa pariveṣṭayet athādhivāsitaṃ devamādāya śvabhramadhyame| 15 saṃsthāpya kūrcān paritaḥ prāgagrāṃścodaga grakān vedyāmupari cārghyāntaṃ jayādī rarcayetkramāt| 16 paṅktīśamamitaṃ vīśaṃ dikpālā nmūrtimantrataḥ kalaśādbāhyato'bhyarcya kalaśeśāna thārcayet 17 śivañca viśvasūnuñca sāmavedañca vatsarān ṛtaḥ prāmaṃ yajū rudramatharvāṇa mathāśvinau 18 tīrthāṃśca lokanāthañca viśmumūrtiṃ garu tataḥ somañca nāgarājañca muniṃ takṣakameva ca 19 puruṣa ñcāpi gandharvān mantraṃ vidyādharān kramāt arkamapsarasastasmi nnekamūrtyā'dhi pāṃ stataḥ 20 hāridre ca sinīvālī marghyāntaṃ cāsanādikam praṇavādi namontaṃ vā dhyātvā mūrtibhirarcayet| 21 paścāddevaṃ praṇamyaiva pādyādyairabhi pūjya ca uttarābhimukhastiṣṭe dgururdevasya dakṣiṇe| 22 tataḥ praṇamya śiṣyastaṃ 'rakṣa' sveti ca mantrataḥ samādāya ca gavyādyaṃ kramāddaste dadedguroḥ 23 punastaṃ praṇavenaiva prokṣyā'dāya samādhinā ādāya vāmahaste taṃ dhṛtvā taditareṇa vai 24 nyastaṃ kūrcaṃ samādāya dravyanāma praśaṃsya ca mantrānte srāvayenmaulau kūrcāgreṇa sakṛtpunaḥ 25 kūrcena sārdhaṃ taddravyaṃ triḥ sakṛtvā pradakṣiṇam viṣṇuñca snāmayāmīti dravyeṇa snāpaye ttataḥ 26 ganyānāṃ pañcakaṃ cātra phalodaṃ pādayoḥ punaḥ saṃsrāvya rājavacchiṣṭaiḥ snāpayeda thavā harim| 27 tataḥ kalaśamādāya śiṣyastaṃ garuhastataḥ pūrvesthāne susannyasya karau prakṣālaye ttathā| 28 'vasoḥ pavitra' mityuktvā 'agna āyāhi' mantrataḥ 'agnimīla' 'iṣe' tveti 'śanno' devī riti kramāt 29 'abhitvā' ca 'imā oṣa' japan catvārivā' giti 'tatpuruṣāyapūte' ti kramā' ccatvāri śṛṅga' taḥ 30 pradhānaiḥ snāpayeddeva mupasnānaistadā budhaḥ 'vārīścatasra' ityuktvā snapayetkalaśaistathā 31 dravyamprati ca vastrādyai rvibhūṣvārghyāntamarcya ca 'śriye jā' teti coktvā'nte hāridraiḥ snāpaye ttathā 32 tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ kalaśeśān visṛjya ca śuddhasnānoktamārgeṇa tailenai vābhiṣeca yet 33 vimṛjya plotavastreṇa śvabhrādādāya cāvyayam yogasane susaṃpthāpya vastrādyairbhūoṣaye ttathā| 34 samabhyarcya tathā'rghā ntyaṃ dānaṃ datvā'tha pūrvavat mahāhaviḥ prabhūtaṃ vā nivedyātraiva cāvyayam| 35 praṇamya daṇḍavadbhū mau prārthanā mantramuccaran vinodānatra kṛtvā'nte guruṃ paścātpra pūjayet 36 punarādāya deveśaṃ kṛtvā dhāma pradakṣiṇam jīvasthāne pratiṣṭāpya pūrvokta ñcātra pūjayet 37 śvabhrādādāya karmānte kautukaṃ yadi mantrataḥ jīvasthāne susaṃsthāpya pūjayeda thavā budhaḥ 38 iti śrī vaikhānase bhagavacchāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ yajñādhikāre sāmānyasnapana vidhirnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|

yajñādhikāraḥ atha saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| cakralakṣaṇam utsavārthaṃ viśeṣeṇa cakramānaṃ pravakṣyate mānāṅgulena vā tasya mānaṃ mātrāṅgulena vā 1 dhruvastāṅgulinā vā'tha kārayedghāṭakādinā yavamātreṇa vistāratoyatāraṃ prakathyate 2 tenaiva samavṛttaṃ taṃ kṛtvā paścādvicakṣaṇaḥ kasya vā caraṇaṃ vargamaśvinyaṅgulā kramāt 3 arāṇāmayutaṃ paśjāddvijena hṛdayaṃ tathā tasya madhyamasūtrasya pārśvayorubhayorapi 4 ekāṅgulaghanaṃ madhyaṃ bahiḥ paṭṭasya pārśvayoḥ yuvāyataghanaṃ tatsyādyathāśobhaṃ kramātkṛtaśam 5 guruścārcādvayārāḥ syuḥ paṅktiyugmamathāntare ṣoḍaśārāstathā hīnāste tvaśrā veṇu patravat 6 tanmūrdhni pārśvayorjvālāścānyāṅgula samāyutam prabhājvālāsamā jñeya stritayā stīkṣṇa darśanāḥ 7 cakreśaṃ hṛdaye tasya navatālena mānataḥ trayodaśāṅgulaiḥ rudranava saptāṅgulaistu vā 8 tacchakrāṅgulinā devaṃ dvibhujaṃ prāñjali yutam āsīnaṃ sthānakaṃ vā'tha kautukaṃ tadyathā tathā 9 sravābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ tattvasmaraṇa saṃyutam pīṭhayuktaṃ viyuktaṃ vā kārayeddhṛdaye'dhipam| 10 karaṇḍakuṭa saṃyuktamardha candrāṅga saṃyutam sumukham cānapāyīśaṃ purataḥ kalpaye ttathā 11 aparaṃ siṃhavadanaṃ padmasya mukula ntu vā kārayedathavā dhīmān pārśvayorubhayorapi 12 cakreśaṃ naiva cakrasya jvālāyuktamathāpi vā padma vā siṃhavaktraṃ vā makarānanameva vā 13 phalakopari vā yoge sthāpayetsudṛḍhaṃ yathā atha vā siṃhayormūrdhni sthāpayetphalakopari 14 taccakrasya samaṃ vā'tha dviguṇaṃ triguṇa ntu vā cakreśasya samaṃ vā'tha gadāyāmaṃ prakathyate 15 yathārhanāha saṃyuktaṃ samavṛttamṛjuṃ tathā phalakākumbhatāṭībhi rbhūṣitāṃ kārayedgadām| 16 cakraṃ tamatha vā dhīmān gadāñcaiva salakṣaṇam sthāpayetpadmapīṭhordhve sudṛḍhaṃ vidhicoditam| 17 caturaṅgulonnataṃ pīṭhamaṣṭāṅgulayutaṃ tathā aśraṃ tatsamavṛttaṃ vā dalairaṣṭabhi rāvṛtam| 18 kārayitvā gadāmūle pūrvavadyojayetkramāt nāgāṅgulodayaṃ kuryādgadāṃ hīne'tha vā yadi 19 atrāpyanuktaṃ yatsarvaṃ kārayecchilpa śāśtravat siddhārcanādikaṃ sarvaṃ kārayetpūrvavadbudhaḥ 20 cakrasthānaprakāraḥ cakrasya sthāpanāmārgaṃ pravakṣyāmi tapodhanāḥ grāmasya yajamānasya cānukūle dine tathā 21 aṅkurasyārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrvameva ca taddināt sambhṛtyaiva ca sambhārān kāraye dakṣiṇocanam 22 tathā'dhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā nadyādau kautukoktavat yāgaśālaṃ tathā kṛtvā bhūṣayettoraṇādibhiḥ 23 śayyāvediñca tanmadhye cādhyardhāyāma vistṛtām turīyāṃśodayāṃ vediṃ kuryāttāṃ caturaśrakām| 24 prācyāmāhavanīyañca kuṇḍamaupāsanāgniv prācyāṃ tatsnāvediñca kṛtvā pūrvoktamānataḥ 25 athādhivāsitañcakra mādāyai vābhiṣicya ca grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā śālāyāṃ sthāpaye ttathā 26 agniṃ saṃsthāpya pūrvoktaṃ kumbhaṃ saṃsādhayetpunaḥ pūrvoktaṃ sumbhamādāya jalenā'pūrva pūrvavat 27 vastrābhyāṃ veṣṭayitvā tu ratnādīntsannyase ttathā cakrasyābhimukhe kumbhaṃ dhānyapīṭhopari nyaset 28 pūjito yajamānena ātmānaṃ bhāvayedguruḥ hṛtpadma madhye cakreśaṃ dvibhuja mañjaliyutam 29 raktābhaṃ pītavastrāṅgaṃ dhyātvā samyak prapūjya ca tasmātkumbhe samāvāhya pūrvoktamabhipūjya ca 30 vedyāṃ saṃsthāpya taccakraṃ kalaśaiḥ snāpayetkramāt samalaṅkṛtya paścādagniṃ paristīrya vaiṣṇavaṃ mantramuccaran 33 'bhūmāna' vandhyona dve ca hutvā gāyatri saṃyutam śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā rātriśeṣaṃ vyapohya ca 34 snātvā prabhūte pūrvoktaṃ cakramādāya pūrvavat dhāma pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā cakreṇasaha mantravit 35 maṇḍape dakṣiṇe pārśve kṛte pīṭhe viśeṣataḥ| ratnaṃ nikṣipya pūrvoktaṃ mantreṇa sthāpaye ttathā 36 cakramantau susañjalya bījātsannyasya pūrvavat saṃhitāyāṃ yajñādhikāre cakralakṣaṇa vidhirnāma saptatiṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|

yajñādhikāraḥ athā'ṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ utsavavidhiḥ| ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi deveśasyotsava kramam kālaśraddhānimittārdhā utsavastrividhāḥ smṛtāḥ 1 māse tu yasmin kasmiṃścit varṣaṃ varṣaṃ pratiprati śāntyarthaṃ sa nimittotsavaḥ smṛtaḥ 4 grāmadau cotsavaḥ syāccetkrameṇaiva ca kārayet tasmādutpātaśāntyarthamā dau kālyutsavaṃ kramāt| 5 anyeṣāṃ krūradevānāṃ śiṣṭabhūtagaṇasya ca śāntyarthaṃ kārayetpaścā cchāstroktaṃ śaṅkarotsavan 6 viśastrigaṇaśāntyarthaṃ saumyamārgeṇa vāstuṣu cakrasenāśa saṃyuktaṃ kuryādgurgotsavaṃ punaḥ 7 sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ munīnāmapi sarvaśaḥ pitṝṇāñca grahāṇāñca patnīnāmapi sarvaśaḥ 8 dvijānāmapi śāntyarthaṃ lokānāmapi sarvaśaḥ puṣṭyarthaṃ kārayetpaścā veśasyotsavaṃ kramāt 9 anyathā cedvināśaḥ syātsarveṣāñca na saṃśayaḥ tasmātpariharedvidvin grāmādau ca viśeṣataḥ 10 ayanādau tu saṅkrāntyāṃ grahaṇe ca viśeṣataḥ tattatkāle ca tīrthaṃ syādrātrāvapi ca kārayet| 11 rāhudarśana saṅkrāntyoḥ snānaṃ śreṣṭa niśāsvapi tathā''huḥ smṛtikārāśca niśāyamani ṣiddhatām| 12 kriyaṃ samāpya madhyāhne rātrau cetsakalaṃ budhaḥ tāvatkālaṃ vinodena nītvā tattīrtha mācaret| 13 viṣṇupañcadineṣvevaṃ māsarkṣe sthāpanādine yajamānasya janmarkṣe rājño janmarkṣa eva vā 14 eteṣvavabhṛthaṃ kalpya cotsavaṃ samyagācaret teṣu kālaśya madhyāhnaḥ pūrvohṇo vā śubhodaye| 15 ṛkṣe tu dvidine saṅge yadahanyadhikaṃ param tathā māsarkṣarāścānye eka māse parasparam 16 dinadyaye tu samprāpte neṣṭaṃ tatprathamaṃ viduḥ tīrthasyātra paraṃ śreṣṭa manyannaimittikeṣu ca 17 pūrṇaparvendu saṃyogaṃ yaddine cobhayorapi tīrthasyātra viśeṣeṇa tatparaṃ vā'nyakarmaṇām 18 pakṣaṃ trayodaśāhaṃ vā dinānyekādaśa kramāt navāhaṃ tatra saptāhaṃ pañcahamathavā punaḥ 19 tridinaṃ dvidinañcaiva ekāha ñcā'tha vā punaḥ atha tīrthadinātpūrvameka viṃśaddhine tathā 20 tathaiva dhvajamāropya nāvāhaṃ cotsavaṃ caret utsavasya dinādau vā ghoṣaṭedvidhi pūrvakam 21 ghoṣaṇādidinātpūrvaṃ kārayedaṅkurārpaṇam veṇuṃ vā jātivṛkṣaṃ vā campakaṃ kramuka ntu vā 22 anyāṃśca śubhavṛkṣānvā cānyeṣāṃ sārameva vā dhvajadaṇḍamṛjuṃ kṛtvā kṛmikoṭara varjitam 23 vimānasya samaṃ vā'tha pādahīnaṃ tathā'dhikam adhyardhaṃ vā'dhikaṃ vā'tha mālādagraṃ kramātkṛśam 24 caturviṃśatyaṅgulanāhaṃ vā yathālābhamathāpi vā gartamānaṃ vinai vā'tra dvajadaṇḍa pramāṇakam 25 yaṣṭiyogaṃ viyogaṃ vā ṛjuṃ kṛtvā salakṣaṇam āhataṃ sudṛḍhaṃ vastraṃ kārpāsaṃ sampragṛhya ca 26 vipulaṃ bhāgatālaṃ syādāyāmaṃ dvādaśāṣṭa vā pādavargasamāyāmaṃ garbhadvārasama ntu vā 27 tadardhavistṛtaṃ vā'tha kārayedvidhi vaddhvajam pūrvoktenaiva mārgeṇa vīśaṃ madhye likhedbudhaḥ 28 yathā'travat tathā dhīmānākāśārohaṇa ntu vā sucitritaṃ dhvajaṃ paścātprokṣya cādāya mantravit 29 ekaviṃśatitālena cāyataṃ veṇuyaṣṭikam ādāyāgrādadhaścātra tviyame 'svastidā' iti 30 badhnīyā ttaddhvajaṃ sthāpanaṃ samyagācaret athavā yājñikairvṛkṣairyaṣṭiṃ kṛtvā sa lakṣaṇam 31 tritālayātamardhaṃ syādvistāraṃ bahulaṃ kramāt āhṛtya yaṣṭyādhārāṇi yojayedacalaṃ kramāt 32 daṇḍāgrādhikaṃ veṇuṃ krameṇaiva ca yojayet tāmreṇa valayaṃ kṛtvā saṃyojya kramaśaḥ sudhīḥ 33 daṇḍadviguṇamāyāma maṅguṣṭāṅgulināhakam trivṛtāṃ tantu nā rajjuṃ kuśarajjumathā'pi vā 34 saṃyojya valaye pūrvaṃ drabhamālāṃ suveṣṭayet balipīṭhātlaścime bhāge madhyasūtrasya madhyame 35 tasmādvyapohya ṣaṭtālaṃ pañcatālaghana ntu vai daṇḍaṃ prakṣālya madhyāhne hemaṃsannyasya cāvaṭe 36 dhvajamantraṃ samucārya daṇḍaṃ saṃsthāpayeddhṛḍham dvihastāyata vistārameka hastādayaṃ kramāt 37 vāruṇyāñca tathotpanne śrīrna tiṣṭhati tadgṛhe 53 vāyavyāñca tadutpanne kanyā gacchati tadgahe saumye tu dṛśyate yatra gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ bhaveddhruvam 54 aiśānye dṛśyate yatra paradeśagataṃ suhṛt dvere tu dṛśyate yatra gṛhaṃ tyajati tadgṛhāt 55 ghṛtakumbhasya pṛṣṭhe te dṛśyante jantavo yadi paśūnāṃ munirukpañca ! śoraiścāpi bhayaṃ bhavet 56 bhaktau tu dṛśyate yatra nistrīkāraṃ sukhaṃ bhavet śayyāsthāne tu dṛśyante prāṇākaśayanādhipāḥ 57 dhānya ṇḍamūle tu dṛśyante jantano yadi gṛhiṇī sā svayameva bhaviṣyati 57 naṣṭānāmetadekaṃ vidhīyate utpannasthānamā … gṛhe cedgṛhaśāntiñca anyatvehaṃ samācaret evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā viṣṇorlokaṃ sa gacchati 61 iti śrīvaikhānase gaptoddhṛtagrāmaśānti vidhirnāma saptacatvāriṃso'dhyāyaḥ|
athāṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ| durgākalpaṃ viśeṣeṇa pravakṣyāmi tapodhanāḥ mārgaśīrṣasya māse tu ārdrāyā marcayetpunaḥ 1 taddinātpūrvato vāpi navame saptame 'pi vā pañcame 'pi tataḥ paścātrtiya he vā'pi kārayet 2 durgābimbaṃ samādāya snānavedyāṃ praveśayet saptabhiḥ kalaśaiḥsnāpya śuddodairabhi ṣecayet 3 saṃsthāpya viṣṭare devīmarcayitvā'ṣṭa vigrahaiḥ havirbhiḥ sannivedyaina mukhavāsaṃ nivedayet 4 ekenaiva vidhānena utsavārambhamācaret grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā praviśedālayaṃ punaḥ 5 āsthāne sthāpya taddevīṃ snāpyābhyarcya viśeṣataḥ śālitaṇḍulamādāya dvidroṇādapyahīnataḥ 6 marīcijīkaghṛtaṃ nālikera phalaṃ tataḥ gulena saha sammiśrya taṇḍulaṃ pramukhe nyaset 7 tannivedya yathāmārgaṃ havirbhaḥ sannivedayet nayā candanaṃ datvā mukhavāsaṃ nivedayet 8 taṇḍulādīn samādāya tadbhaktebhyaḥ pradīyatām ve sāntakam 9 samāptidivase devīṃ samabhyarcya viśeṣataḥ saptamātṝḥ tatassapta samabhyarcya nivedayet 10 tatta ddhaste suvarṇena sodakaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadet hiraṇyaṃ mukhavāsañca brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradīyatām 11 sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ vāstugānaṃ supūjayet paścāddevīṃ nivedyaiva bahubhiḥpāyasādibhiḥ 12 mukhavāsaṃ nivedyaiva gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadet jīvasthāne pratiṣṭāpya puṣpāñjali mathācaret 13 bimbābhāve paṭe lekhyāmācaredvidhi pūrvakam snapanañcaiva kṛtvā'gre prokṣaṇaiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ caret 14 evaṃ samarcayeddevīṃ deśaśāntikaraṃ bhavet iti śrī vaikhānase durgākalpa vidhirnāma aṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
athaukonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi grāmānte tu samarcanam kautukaṃ snapanañcaiva nityanaimittikeṣu ca 1 dvitīyāvarṇādarvāk kārayediti śāsanam autsavaṃ baliberañca yojanānte samācaret 2 mohādajñānato vā'pi rājarāṣṭraṃ vinaśyaiva grāmanāśaṃ bhaviṣyati 3 tasmācchāntiñca kṛtvā tu punaḥ karma samācaret paracakrabhayañcaiva rāṣṭragrāmadi saṅkule 4 kautukādīn samādāya sudeśe sthāpya cārcayet paścātsukāle deveśaṃ pūrvasthāne niveśayet 5 taddoṣamanārthāya pakṣaṃ saptāhameva vā adbhutāṃ śāntimācarya paścāt sthāpanamācaret 6 ekamāse prakurvīta dvimāse dviguṇaṃ bhavet trimāse triguṇaṃ proktaṃ caturthe caturācaret 7 vatsarānte sukāla ñce nmāsaśāntiñca kārayet karṣaṇādi punassarvamācarediti śāsanam 8 rājarāṣṭrābhivṛddhiśca grāmaśāntikaraṃ bhavet tataḥ kośāntarāṇyanu sarasyasamagrā ca|
